{{Quote|This is the cylinder I wanted, but I can't crack the code. I need someone to take the cylinder to a scientist I know. He can decode it.|[[Barada/Legends|Barada]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
'''Tiem Rutnar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:B" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] head [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Barada/Legends|Barada]] requested Tiem Rutnar to decode a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] containing the self-destruct code for a storehouse of the [[Valarian Syndicate]].<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateAakuanAnarchist.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Tiem Rutnar]]
Tiem Rutnar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Due to the nature of some characters in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', Tiem Rutnar's gender and appearance were randomized during each server reset.<ref name="SWG:B" />

Tiem Rutnar was present in the original release of the game, being part of the first version of [[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Jabba's Theme Park]].<ref name="SWG:B" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> [[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]] was deeply revamped and Tiem Rutnar was removed from the game.<ref name="SWG:JPB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Barada|Tatooine}}</ref>
